note: Themes offered in Settings. Each is a pair: `bg/<key>.jpg` behind the page and `hero/<key>.jpg` in the dashboard's hero card. `tone` says which ink a page title takes over the backdrop. `ratio` and `subtitleRatio` are the worst pixel under the title's and the subtitle's own bounding box, measured on the rendered page with the backdrop's real filter, cover-fit and scrim applied — not on the raw file, which reads differently. `heroRatio` is the worst case for white text across the hero image's bottom 45% with --scrim-image-card applied. Floors: 4.5 for text on the backdrop, 7 for the hero. These must match the table in DESIGN.md section 3.2; if they ever disagree, one of them is invented and both need re-measuring.
